method: PLAN 1b.2 (2026-09-19): one note per instrument at +50% of full bend, differenced in CENTS against the same pitch and velocity unbent; f0 by autocorrelation searched within +/-6 semitones of the written note. Measured on THIS rack with REC at unity, so the reading is independent of any trim. One fraction only - enough for the range the piece asks (<=50 cents) and not enough to see non-linearity, which is what the full bend probe (probes/analyze_bend_probe.py) is for.

slots.what: the unbent baseline every cents figure is measured against
bent +50 %, NOT reset after — the residue trap set
the next note with no bend message — sharp = the residue is real
RPN 0 asked for 12 semitones, then full bend up — wider than +100 = RPN honoured
RPN 0 back to 2, full bend up — the same as +100 = restored

_provenance: Skeleton written by the port, 2026-09-17 (PLAN 0b step 4). Shape and metadata are piece #5's; of the measurements ONLY THE CELLO'S are kept — it is the same library and the same instrument (D6). Every other instrument of this piece is unmeasured: PLAN 0d fills this in, and until it does the app falls back exactly as it does for any missing row.

_1b2.what: All seven pitched instruments measured on this rack on one day. Before this, only the CELLO had ever been measured (piece #5, carried with the recipe); the english horn and double bass carried an INFERRED 1 st and the rest the provisional 2.
_1b2.finding: Every inference was right within 0.1 st: english horn 0.92 - double bass 0.90 - cello 1.01 (#5 read 0.97) - bassoon 1.99 - horn 2.00 - trumpet 2.00. So RUNNING_LOG 74s bend-range hypothesis for the wide glissandos is DEFINITIVELY DEAD; 75 had already found the real cause.

_piece5.method: f0 by energy-normalised autocorrelation within +/-6 semitones of the written note (the RPN slots also an octave up); rangeSt = median over +50 / +100 / -100 % of |measured cents - reference| / fraction; residue = the plain note after an unreset +50 % bend; RPN honoured if full bend after RPN 0 = 12 reads > 1.5x full bend before; restored if the last slot is within 10 c of +100 %; scoop = the +100 slot's onset-vs-settled less the reference's own (the attack's wobble), pre-arm OK within 10 c
_piece5.note: piece #5s bend probe, carried by the port with the cello recipe; superseded for this rack by 1b.2 but kept as the record
